Find Your Interest – Find Your Passion
Please be sure to review the web pages of the colleges you are considering. Each college provides detailed information about its graduate programs, including specific options, admission requirements, procedures, and deadlines. Always consult the appropriate graduate catalog for the most current and authoritative information regarding degree programs.
Please note that departments may have additional admission requirements that do not appear on the School of Graduate and Professional Studies website.

Welcome to Tennessee State University’s School of Graduate & Professional Studies where education is designed to offer students the experience of advanced study and research in their fields of specialization. Together with the graduate faculty, we provide a learning environment that ensures our students acquire the skills they will need to succeed in their future career endeavors. We invite you to explore graduate education and research opportunities at our institution.
Application
Career Development Center
College of Agriculture
The College of Agriculture provides hands-on learning and research opportunities that prepare students for careers in agriculture, environmental sciences, food systems, and related industries that impact communities worldwide.
Learn More
College of Business
The College of Business develops future leaders through innovative programs, real-world experiences, and strong industry connections that prepare students for success in today’s global economy.
Learn More
College of Education
The College of Education equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to inspire future generations and lead in classrooms, communities, and educational organizations.
Learn More
College of Engineering
The College of Engineering prepares students to solve complex challenges through cutting-edge technology, research, and experiential learning across a variety of engineering disciplines.
Learn More
College of Health Sciences
The College of Health Sciences offers rigorous programs and clinical experiences that prepare students for rewarding careers dedicated to improving the health and well-being of individuals and communities.
Learn More
College of Liberal Arts
The Criminal Justice Department under the College of Liberal Arts provides students with a strong foundation in justice, leadership, and public safety, preparing them for impactful careers in law enforcement, corrections, and related fields.
Learn More
College of Life and Physical Sciences
The College of Life and Physical Sciences fosters scientific discovery and innovation through programs that prepare students for careers in research, healthcare, biotechnology, and the natural sciences.
Learn More
College of Public Service
The College of Public Service empowers students to make a difference through programs focused on social work, public administration, urban studies, and professional studies, with an emphasis on serving communities and advancing the public good.
Learn More
Non-Degree Programs
Non-degree programs offer flexible learning opportunities for individuals seeking professional development, personal enrichment, or specialized knowledge without pursuing a traditional degree.
Learn More
